message.content: Test of a UI. Do not read or change files. Call the AskUserQuestion tool once with two questions: 1) header 'Store', a long question of about 220 characters about which storage engine the sync service should use for the event log when it runs on a small Mac with little disk, options SQLite, JSON files, Postgres; 2) header 'Tests', multiSelect true, question 'Which tests do you want?', options Unit, Live, Snapshot. After the answer, reply with one word: done.

questions.question: Which storage engine should the sync service use for the event log when it runs on a small Mac with little disk space? Each option has different disk use, write speed, and setup effort, so choose the one that best fits a constrained machine.

options.label: SQLite
options.description: Single file, low disk overhead, no server process. Good fit for a small Mac.

options.label: JSON files
options.description: Simplest format to read and debug. Uses the most disk and is slow to append at scale.

options.label: Postgres
options.description: Full database server. Highest disk and memory cost, so it suits a larger host better.

options.label: Unit
options.description: Fast tests for each target, run with swift test.

options.label: Live
options.description: Read-only calls to real services. Runs only with OVERSIRE_LIVE=1.

options.label: Snapshot
options.description: Fixed UI screenshots from the fakes, via --uishots.
